20:00 │ EN VIVO AHORA: NHL Hockey
The Carolina Hurricanes battle the Boston Bruins in NHL regular-season action at Lenovo Center. The Hurricanes have won three of the last five meetings between these sides, including a 6-5 overtime win at Lenovo Center last April.

22:30 │ A CONTINUACIÓN: NHL Hockey
The San Jose Sharks host the Buffalo Sabres at SAP Center in NHL action. San Jose relies on home-ice execution to snap a skid against Buffalo, while Buffalo counts on recent head-to-head dominance following a 5-0 shutout victory in their last trip.
